definitions.gloss: acting on behalf of, performing duties as a substitute
definitions.explanation: Carrying out tasks or responsibilities in place of someone else. Used for both formal delegation and commercial proxy services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代行|だいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: To serve as a substitute for the department head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧{代行|だいこう}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}した→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I used a designated driver service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、{副社長|ふくしゃちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{代行|だいこう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: While the president is away, the vice president is handling the duties on his behalf.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代行|だいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to act on behalf of)
- {代行|だいこう}{者|しゃ} (proxy, substitute person)
- {代行|だいこう}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (proxy service)
- ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧{代行|だいこう} (designated driver service)
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{代行|だいこう} (business proxy, outsourcing)

CULTURAL NOTE: ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧{代行|だいこう} is a popular service in Japan where a professional driver takes you and your car home when you've been drinking. It is widely available near entertainment districts.
